brief: A portfolio for Mira Okafor, a freelance children's-book illustrator in Lisbon. Show 6 recent books with cover placeholders, a short bio, the publishers she has worked with as plain text, and a contact section for commissions.

Landing page for Tallyhook, invoicing software for freelance video editors. It turns timeline exports into invoices. Explain the 3-step workflow, show pricing (Free, Pro at $12/month, Studio at $29/month), answer 5 common questions, and end with a sign-up call to action.

Website for Shio & Smoke, a 28-seat ramen bar in Leeds. Show the short menu (5 bowls, 4 sides, prices in pounds), opening hours, a note that they don't take bookings, the story of the founder's 3 years in Sapporo, and how to find them.

One-page site for the Harrow Letterpress Fair, a two-day print fair on 14–15 March. List 24 exhibiting studios as names only, 4 workshops with times, ticket prices (day £8, weekend £12, under-16s free), the venue, and accessibility information.

Product launch page for the Kestrel G1, a flat-burr espresso grinder. The hero should be an interactive 3D view of the grinder that turns as you scroll. Then cover the 64mm burrs, single-dosing design, noise level (58 dB), price ($449), and a pre-order form.

A long-read feature page titled 'The Last Glacier Keepers' about scientists who measure a shrinking Alpine glacier every September. Include a standfirst, three chapters with pull quotes, an image slot per chapter, and an author note. Make it feel like a printed magazine.

Site for Clearwater Collective, a volunteer group cleaning the river Wey. Show the next 3 cleanup dates, what volunteers should bring, the impact so far (412 volunteers and 6.3 tonnes of rubbish removed in 2024), and a donate section.

Landing page for burrow, an open-source command-line tool that finds unused files in large monorepos. Show the install command, a terminal example of its output, 4 key flags in a table, benchmark numbers for 3 repo sizes, and links to docs and GitHub.

A scroll story for a single-origin coffee from the Huila region: the page should pin and walk the visitor through 4 stages (picking, washing, drying on raised beds, roasting) with each stage revealing as they scroll, then end with a buy section for 250 g bags.

Website for Dunmore Plumbing & Heating, a two-person business in Belfast. List services (boiler servicing, leaks, bathroom fits), a 24-hour emergency phone number, the areas they cover, 3 customer reviews, and a simple quote request form.

Site for 'Small Hours', a weekly podcast about overlooked inventions. Show the latest episode with an audio player slot, the 6 previous episodes with dates and run times, the two hosts, and where to subscribe.

Portfolio for Ferro Lund, a small architecture studio that designs timber schools. Show 5 projects with large image slots that drift with parallax as you scroll, the studio's three principles, the team of 7, and a contact section. Motion should feel slow and calm.

Website for Ironleaf, a strength-training studio for people over 50. Show the weekly class timetable, 3 coaches with short bios, a free first-session offer, membership prices, and directions with parking information.

A wedding site for Priya and Tomasz, marrying on 6 September in a converted barn near Ludlow. Include the day's schedule, travel and accommodation, a dress code note, the gift list approach (a honeymoon fund), and an RSVP form with dietary needs.

Page for a museum exhibition called 'Deep Time' about 4 billion years of rock. The hero should show a slowly rotating 3D layered rock section the visitor can drag. Then list the 5 exhibition rooms, ticket prices, opening hours, and school group bookings.

Launch page for 'Lantern Dive', a cozy underwater exploration game for PC and Switch. Use bold color and playful motion: a scrolling marquee of features, a trailer slot, 4 screenshots, release date (3 April), platforms, and a wishlist button. Make it loud and fun.

Website for The Tidewater, a 12-room hotel in a former harbour office in St Ives. Show the room types with prices per night, breakfast details, 3 things to do nearby, guest reviews, and a booking enquiry form.

One-page site for Margins 2026, a one-day conference about accessible design on 18 June in Utrecht. Show 8 speakers with talk titles, the schedule, ticket tiers (student €60, standard €180), the code of conduct summary, and the venue's accessibility details.
Shop front for Kiln & Clay, a potter selling small batches of tableware. Show 8 products with prices, the next batch release date, care instructions, shipping costs, and the potter's short story.

Landing page for Pennywise, a budgeting app for students that splits rent and bills between housemates. Explain how splitting works in 3 steps, show the app screens as image slots, list privacy promises, show it is free with an optional £2/month plan, and add app store buttons.
